hypotheses.statement: A call sequence reaching UTB.bridgeAndExecute may reach a state violating 'authorization-conservation', root-cause class 'alt-entrypoint-auth-bypass' (grounded on c4.2024-01-decent.M-03).

invariant.name: authorization-conservation
invariant.description: [access-control-consistency] Every execution of the privileged effect was authorized through the canonical gate: count(privileged-effect) == count(authorized-invocations).
invariant.control_expectation: one honest, authorized call: +1 effect, +1 authorization -> equal.
invariant.break_expectation: attacker triggers the effect without authorization: effects > authorizations.
invariant.measured_quantity: count of privileged effect vs count of authorized (paid/signed) invocations

attack_sketch: Reach UTB.bridgeAndExecute as an unprivileged caller.
Drive the privileged effect via the shape: public receiveFromBridge calls internal _swapAndExecute, skipping the retrieveAndCollectFees modifier.
Observe the break: attacker triggers the effect without authorization: effects > authorizations.

hypotheses.statement: A call sequence reaching UTBFeeCollector.collectFees may reach a state violating 'signature-authenticity', root-cause class 'signature-malleability' (grounded on oak.sig.malleable).

invariant.name: signature-authenticity
invariant.description: [replay-resistance] A privileged effect occurs only under a signature by the trusted signer over exactly the parameters that drive the effect.
invariant.baseline_expectation: no effect without a signer-bound signature.
invariant.control_expectation: a correctly signed call produces the effect.
invariant.break_expectation: an effect occurs under a forged/zero/unbound signature.
invariant.measured_quantity: effects vs effects backed by a valid signer-bound signature
